name: ai-feature
title: AI feature - eval-first LLM integration with guardrails
titleAr: ميزة ذكاء اصطناعي — تقييم الأول ← تكامل LLM بضوابط أمان
description: Adds or improves an LLM-powered feature (prompting, RAG, tool calling, agents) the way production teams do: an evaluation set with measurable pass criteria exists before the feature, tests run against a deterministic mock provider, guardrails cover the OWASP LLM Top 10, and the tester re-runs the evals to prove the target score.

stages.title: AI integration map
stages.prompt:
AI feature: {TASK}

Project root: {PROJECT}. Map the existing AI integration: SDKs and providers in use, where prompts live, model and parameter configuration, how API keys are read (environment variable NAMES only, never values), retrieval sources, tool/function definitions, existing mocks or fixtures for model calls, and any cost, latency or rate-limit constants. Cite file:line. Write analysis.md per your role contract.
done: analysis.md maps SDKs, prompts, model configuration and key handling with file:line citations
analysis.md states whether a mock or fixture for model calls exists

stages.title: Eval-first design
stages.prompt:
AI feature: {TASK}

Grounding: .workbench/artifacts/analysis.md (project {PROJECT}). Produce the plan per your role contract, eval-first: an evaluation set (typical, edge and adversarial cases including prompt injection and data-exfiltration attempts) with measurable pass criteria and a target score (for example schema-valid rate, rubric or exact-match accuracy, p95 latency, cost per call); a provider abstraction with a deterministic mock so tests never need the network; guardrails for the OWASP LLM Top 10 (prompt injection, insecure output handling, sensitive information disclosure, excessive agency, unbounded consumption); timeouts, retries and fallback behavior; and logging without secrets or personal data. Write it to .workbench/artifacts/plan.md.
stages.gateQuestion: Review the eval set and design in plan.md - build it?
stages.gateQuestionAr: راجع مجموعة التقييم والتصميم في plan.md — نبنيه؟
done: plan.md exists and contains all required sections (Task, Requirements, Chosen approach, Steps, Acceptance criteria, Risks)
plan.md defines an evaluation set with adversarial cases, measurable pass criteria and a target score
plan.md specifies a deterministic mock provider and guardrails for prompt injection, output handling and secret disclosure

stages.title: Build the evals first
stages.prompt: In the project at {PROJECT}, build ONLY the evaluation harness, the eval cases and the mock provider from .workbench/artifacts/plan.md, using the repository's existing test runner or an eval tool the project already uses. Run the evals against the current code with the mock and record the baseline score - failing cases are expected before the feature exists. Make no paid model API call unless the task or inbox explicitly allows it. Write code-notes.md per your role contract with `## Eval baseline` (command, score, per-case results, and the `git hash-object` value of every eval case file).
done: The eval harness, eval cases and mock provider exist, following the repository's test conventions
code-notes.md contains an Eval baseline section with the command, score and eval case file hashes
No paid model API call was made unless explicitly allowed

stages.title: Implement the feature
stages.prompt: Implement the AI feature from .workbench/artifacts/plan.md in the project at {PROJECT}. Keep secrets in environment variables, validate and encode model output before it reaches users, tools or queries, enforce timeouts and token limits, and never edit eval cases to raise the score. Re-run the evals with the mock provider (live only if explicitly allowed). Keep the Eval baseline section of code-notes.md, complete the rest per your role contract, and add `## Eval result` (command, score versus target, per-case results).
done: Every plan step is implemented or its omission is explicitly justified in code-notes.md
code-notes.md keeps the Eval baseline and adds an Eval result section with score versus target
No eval case file was modified after the baseline

stages.title: Re-run the evals
stages.prompt: Verify the AI feature in the project at {PROJECT}. Checks output (if any) is in .workbench/artifacts/checks.md. Re-run the evals yourself with the mock provider and compare with the target in plan.md; mark live-model evals NOT TESTABLE unless explicitly allowed. Confirm eval case files still match the hashes in code-notes.md, adversarial cases pass, no secret or key appears in code, logs or fixtures, model output is validated before use, and timeouts and error paths are tested. Write review.md per your role contract and lead your reply with VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL.
done: review.md exists with an explicit Verdict line
review.md quotes its own eval re-run with the score versus the target
review.md confirms eval case hashes match, adversarial cases pass and no secret is present in the diff

stages.title: Fix eval failures
stages.prompt: The tester issued FAIL for the AI feature in the project at {PROJECT} (details in .workbench/artifacts/review.md). Fix the feature, prompts or guardrails - never the eval cases or the target. Write/append debug.md per your role contract.
done: Every blocking finding from review.md is addressed or refuted with evidence
No eval case or target was changed to force a pass
debug.md shows the failing output before and the passing output after

stages.title: Ship the AI feature
stages.prompt: The AI feature PASSED review. Package it for the project at {PROJECT} per your role contract. Mode: {SHIP_MODE}. The commit message states the eval score versus target; list required environment variables under Follow-ups. Write ship.md.
stages.gateQuestion: AI feature met its eval target - commit it?
stages.gateQuestionAr: ميزة الـ AI وصلت لهدف التقييم — أعمل commit؟
done: ship.md exists with summary, file list, commit message, and actions taken
No .workbench/ or local-only files staged
The commit message states the eval score versus the target
